# Solar Surf — Mount Maunganui Surfboard Repairs

> Solar Surf is the Mount's original surf shop and board repair workshop, operating in Mount Maunganui, New Zealand since 1974. Fibreglass, epoxy and composite board repairs: dings, rails, snaps, re-finishing, SUPs. Rated 5.0 from 23 Google reviews.

Key facts: Since 1974 · 5.0 stars (23 reviews) · Repairs usually take a few days · Ding repairs from $60, medium from $80 · Always quoted before work starts · Open 7 days — someone is usually at the workshop 9:30am–4:00pm · Unit 8, 21 MacDonald Street, Mount Maunganui 3116 · Phone 027 5888 082 · mountmaunganui@me.com · Instagram @solarsurfnz · Mike in Unit 9 can take drop-offs and pickups

## Services
Ding repairs, snapped board repairs, rail repairs, re-finishing from $100 (strip and clean old wax and grime, spray finish, wet and dry sanding for maximum performance), SUP and foil board repairs, all fibreglass/epoxy watercraft. Drop-off during opening hours or by arrangement.

## Quote
Text a photo of the damage to 027 5888 082 for a fast quote before drop-off.
